about: The land acknowledgement on the new-world title (title-intro.mjs), set like a film's opening card. The title names the panel for screen readers; it is not shown.
title: Before this forest

paragraphs.text: Before our forest, there was land. Before our story, there were peoples who named its waters, sang its seasons, and cared for it—and who care for it still.
We honour the first keepers of the lands beneath our homes and machines, and the countless voices that taught those machines to speak.
We offer back a carved wooden box, with a forest folded inside.
The lid is open. The path is yours.
